snippet.title: Rhapsody in Scarlet - Story Trailer (ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
New York City in the 1920s—a dazzling metropolis filled with the sound of jazz and the glow of soaring skyscrapers.
While the city reveled in its glamour, an unseen conflict simmered among those who practiced magick in secret.

Arriving in New York to pursue a career as a jazz singer, the young magus Ellie soon finds herself caught in an unexpected incident. The encounter leads her to Ilya, leader of the Seekers, an elite organization of magi.
Though the free-spirited Ellie and the serious-minded Ilya frequently clash, they gradually forge a strong bond as they investigate the schemes of a mysterious mafia organization.
Their investigation draws them ever deeper into the city's secrets, revealing a fateful battle that threatens the very balance of the world.

An epic tale unfolds where beasts, magick, friendship, and destiny intertwine.
